concerns.text: The data model defines a `ProblemPair` entity persisted as `data/raw/problem_pairs_v{hash}.jsonl` (see data-model.md). The plan never describes creating this combined JSONL file; it only mentions separate human and LLM files under `data/raw/` and `data/generated/`. This omission breaks the Plan ↔ data‑model contract.

The `FuzzResult` contract requires an `execution_status` field (enum: success, timeout, compile_fail). The plan describes running libFuzzer with a hard timeout but does not state that the resulting JSONL will record the status for each binary, nor that the `model` identifier will be stored. Add explicit wording to capture these fields.
